question: After the required document structure is restored, should OpenClaw adopt the revised one-Claw-one-new-agent package and lifecycle contract?
rationale: The proposal creates durable CLI, manifest, ownership, provenance, and upgrade surfaces; document correctness cannot determine whether those should become supported OpenClaw product contracts.

options.title: Accept after structure repair
options.body: Approve the revised contract, create the implementation issue, and transition the RFC to accepted before merge.

options.title: Narrow before acceptance
options.body: Accept a smaller initial package lifecycle and defer selected update, export, MCP, cron, or shared-package semantics.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep the RFC in draft while implementation experience resolves remaining compatibility choices.

recommendation.title: Accept after structure repair
recommendation.body: Approve the revised contract, create the implementation issue, and transition the RFC to accepted before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete product-model revision adopted by the current proposal and are the strongest visible discussion-based owner for the contract decision.
